name: Restaurant Stocks vs SPY: Macro Stress Outperformance
description: Do restaurant stocks (MCD, DRI, YUM, CMG, SBUX) outperform SPY during macro stress (slowing PCE + rising unemployment)? 63-day rolling return spread with regime shading, PCE-vs-spread scatter with OLS trend, and regime-conditioned summary statistics.
source:
# ============================================================
# Restaurant Basket vs SPY — Macro Stress Outperformance Study
# ============================================================
# Thesis: Do restaurant stocks outperform during slowing consumer
# spending + rising unemployment?
# Basket: equal-weight MCD, DRI, YUM, CMG, SBUX
# Benchmark: SPY
# Macro stress: PCE MoM < its 3M avg AND UNRATE > 3M ago
# ============================================================

# --- Data: Stocks via reference_assets (assets=[]) ---
mcd = reference_assets(stock("MCD"))()
dri = reference_assets(stock("DRI"))()
yum = reference_assets(stock("YUM"))()
cmg = reference_assets(stock("CMG"))()
sbux = reference_assets(stock("SBUX"))()
spy = reference_assets(stock("SPY"))()

# --- Data: Macro (ffill sparse monthly → daily) ---
# DPCERAM1M225NBEA: Real PCE MoM % change (values like 0.3 = 0.3%)
pce_mom_pct = ffill(economic_indicators(series_id="DPCERAM1M225NBEA").result)
# UNRATE: Unemployment rate (values like 4.0 = 4.0%)
unrate_pct = ffill(economic_indicators(series_id="UNRATE").result)

# --- 63-Day Returns (≈3 months rolling) ---
ret_mcd = returns(mcd.c, 63)
ret_dri = returns(dri.c, 63)
ret_yum = returns(yum.c, 63)
ret_cmg = returns(cmg.c, 63)
ret_sbux = returns(sbux.c, 63)
ret_spy = returns(spy.c, 63)

# Equal-weight restaurant basket 63-day return (decimal)
basket_ret = (ret_mcd + ret_dri + ret_yum + ret_cmg + ret_sbux) / 5.0

# Relative performance spread: positive = restaurant outperformance
spread = basket_ret - ret_spy

# --- Macro Stress Regime ---
# PCE slowing: current MoM below its 3-month moving average
pce_ma3m = sma(pce_mom_pct, 63)
pce_slowing = pce_mom_pct < pce_ma3m

# Labor deteriorating: UNRATE rising vs 3 months ago
unrate_3m_ago = unrate_pct >> 63
labor_worsening = unrate_pct > unrate_3m_ago

# Both conditions simultaneously = macro stress
is_stress = pce_slowing and labor_worsening
stress_band = 1.0 if is_stress else 0.0

# --- Unit conversion for PercentFormat ---
# PercentFormat auto-multiplies by 100. UNRATE/PCE are already in %
# (4.0 = 4%), so divide by 100 first: 4.0/100 = 0.04 → displays "4.0%"
# Spread/returns are already decimal (0.05 = 5%) → displays correctly
unrate_dec = unrate_pct / 100.0
pce_dec = pce_mom_pct / 100.0

# Timestamp for x-axis
ts = index().value

# ============================================================
# CHART 1 — Time-Series: Spread + Macro Overlay + Stress Shading
# ============================================================
xy_lines(
    title="Restaurant Basket vs SPY: 3M Return Spread & Macro Context",
    y_axis_label="Value (%)",
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    x_axis_label="Date",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Restaurant-SPY Spread", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Unemployment Rate", color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="PCE MoM Change", color=Color.Teal, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Macro Stress Period", color=Color.Red, is_band=True)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title="Zero Spread", color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    category="Macro Stress Analysis",
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(spread, unrate_dec, pce_dec, stress_band))

# ============================================================
# CHART 2 — Scatter: PCE MoM vs Spread by Regime
# ============================================================
# Sample at month-end for clean monthly observations
is_eom = is_month_end(index(), offset=0)
has_data = is_eom and is_valid(spread) and is_valid(pce_mom_pct)

# Monthly sampled series (sparse — NaN on non-EOM bars)
pce_monthly = where(has_data, pce_dec)
spread_monthly = where(has_data, spread)

# Split spread by regime for color coding
spread_stress = where(has_data and is_stress, spread)
spread_nonstress = where(has_data and not is_stress, spread)

xy_scatter(
    title="Does Slowing Consumer Spending Help Restaurants?",
    x_axis_label="PCE MoM Change (%)",
    y_axis_label="Restaurant-SPY 3M Spread (%)",
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_dp=1,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    series=ScatterSeriesSchema(series=[
        ScatterSeriesSpec(name="Macro Stress", color=Color.Red, marker=MarkerSymbol.DiamondMarker),
        ScatterSeriesSpec(name="Non-Stress", color=Color.Blue, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title="Zero Spread", color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title="Zero PCE", color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, vertical=True)
    ]),
    show_trend_line=True,
    category="Macro Stress Analysis",
    order=2
)(x=pce_monthly, y_values=(spread_stress, spread_nonstress))

# ============================================================
# TABLE — Summary by Macro Regime (Stress vs Non-Stress)
# ============================================================
# Monthly sampled metrics for each regime
basket_monthly = where(has_data, basket_ret)
spy_monthly = where(has_data, ret_spy)
unrate_monthly = where(has_data, unrate_dec)

# Hit rate: 1 if spread > 0, else 0 (dense ternary for correct Mean)
hit_all = 1.0 if (is_valid(spread) and spread > 0) else 0.0

# Stress regime filtered (sparse — NaN on non-event bars)
s_spread = where(has_data and is_stress, spread)
s_hit = where(has_data and is_stress, hit_all)
s_basket = where(has_data and is_stress, basket_ret)
s_spy = where(has_data and is_stress, ret_spy)
s_unrate = where(has_data and is_stress, unrate_dec)
s_pce = where(has_data and is_stress, pce_dec)

# Non-stress regime filtered
ns_spread = where(has_data and not is_stress, spread)
ns_hit = where(has_data and not is_stress, hit_all)
ns_basket = where(has_data and not is_stress, basket_ret)
ns_spy = where(has_data and not is_stress, ret_spy)
ns_unrate = where(has_data and not is_stress, unrate_dec)
ns_pce = where(has_data and not is_stress, pce_dec)

summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title="Restaurant Outperformance by Macro Regime",
        row_size=2, col_size=7,
        row_headers=["Macro Stress", "Non-Stress"],
        col_headers=[
            "Avg Spread vs SPY",
            "Hit Rate (>0)",
            "Avg Basket 3M Ret",
            "Avg SPY 3M Ret",
            "Avg UNRATE",
            "Avg PCE MoM",
            "# Obs"
        ],
        cells=[
            # Row 0: Macro Stress
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=5, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=6, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            # Row 1: Non-Stress
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=5, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=6, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat)
        ]
    ),
    category="Macro Stress Analysis",
    order=3
)((s_spread, s_hit, s_basket, s_spy, s_unrate, s_pce, s_spread,
   ns_spread, ns_hit, ns_basket, ns_spy, ns_unrate, ns_pce, ns_spread))

# ============================================================
# EVENT MARKERS — Stress Regime Onset
# ============================================================
# Detect transition into stress (was not stress, now is stress)
stress_onset = is_stress and not (is_stress >> 1)

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title="Macro Stress Onset",
        icon=Icon.AlertTriangleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Regime", type=CardRenderType.TextFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title="Spread vs SPY", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title="UNRATE", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title="PCE MoM", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(("Stress Begins", spread, unrate_dec, pce_dec, stress_onset))
